en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a compact town in a narrow Alpine valley. Dense clusters of mid‑rise buildings with pitched roofs fill the valley floor, surrounded by terraced fields and meadows. Steep, forested mountains rise sharply on both sides, with higher snow‑covered peaks visible in the background. A river or torrent runs along the valley bottom, paralleled by a road, and a few larger, possibly hotel‑like buildings stand at the edge of town. The image has the classic framing and style of a mid‑20th‑century landscape postcard.
